summary:
Co-Founder & Co-CEO of Plantura – We Grow Happiness.
Plantura is Germany's leading digital platform for plants and plant care. We combine a curated marketplace with 1,500+ plants from top nurseries, sustainable own-brand care products, and an AI-powered plant companion app with 2M+ installs – all reinforcing each other in what we call the Plantura Flywheel.
The €18bn+ German garden market is going digital – and our 65-person team of passionate experts is leading the way.

company.description:
Bringing nature home! That is our mission at Plantura. We want to reconnect people with nature and make the world a little bit greener every day! How?

By providing everything people need to live a greener and healthier life in an easy and joyful way: 

- A curated one-stop-shop, offering indoor & outdoor plants, plant care (like vegan fertilizers and CO2 reduced soils), plant protection and beneficial organisms
- An app that takes you by the hand with smart features & digital guidance
- And an online magazine that is your go-to place for every-day inspirational content & how-to instructions 

In this huge and sometimes overlooked segment of home & garden, there is room for a truly sustainable and authentic brand! 

Feel like joining our mission? Then please get in touch or check out our open positions.
